description: [Procurement] Get the new EU public tenders that match a company's criteria since the last check. Use when running a daily tender alert or bid-pipeline feed. Price: $0.10 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/tender-alerts

countries.description: Comma-separated buyer countries, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. DE,FR,PL). Optional.

cpv.description: Comma-separated CPV codes (8 digits; a division such as 72000000 also matches its sub-codes). Up to 20.

include_no_value.description: When min_value/max_value is set, also return notices that state no value (default false).

max_value.description: Maximum estimated value in EUR. Optional.

min_value.description: Minimum estimated value in EUR (non-EUR values converted with ECB reference rates). Optional.

notice_types.description: competition (default: contract notices and calls for competition), award (contract award notices) or all.

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time; notices published on or after this date (TED publication date, Brussels time). Default: 24 hours ago. At most 31 days back.

name: tender_alerts
title: EU Tender Alerts (new TED notices) ($0.10)
